title: Notes
emptyNotes: There are no notes yet. Create a new note to begin.
emptyTrashDescription: Deleted notes appear here until you empty the trash.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed ({{code}})
errors.notFound: The note no longer exists. The list was reloaded.
errors.notFoundRecovered: The note no longer existed; your text was saved as a new note.

confirmEmptyMessage: Notes in the trash will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
emptyArchivedDescription: Notes you archive will appear here.

vault.notice: A private note is stored encrypted and can only be opened with your password.
vault.rules: Use 6–10 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character.
vault.question: Question {{number}}
vault.wait: Too many failed attempts. Wait {{seconds}} seconds.
vault.waitAgain: Invalid credentials. Wait before trying again.
vault.invalid: Could not complete the action. Check your password or answers and try again.
vault.unlockFirst: Unlock the vault to make this note private.
vault.saveFailed: The latest changes could not be saved. Saving will be retried when you edit again.
vault.draftRestored: The latest changes were not saved; they have been restored so you can save them
vault.noticeLocal: Content is encrypted on this computer, never leaves it, and does not appear in search. The title remains visible in the list: do not put sensitive data in it.
vault.noticeQuestions: One password (6 to 10 characters) works for all your private notes, with two security questions to reset it.
vault.noticeLoss: If you forget the password and the answers, private notes cannot be recovered.
vault.steps: Step 1 of 2 · Password · Step 2 of 2 · Questions
vault.answerLength: Answers must contain between 2 and 20 characters.
vault.questionsHelp: Two questions to reset your password if you forget it. Answers are case and accent insensitive.
vault.unlockHelp: Enter your password to view and edit private notes.
vault.autoLock: Notes lock again when you leave Notes or after 10 minutes of inactivity. With a note open, the title lock locks them immediately.
vault.passwordRemaining_one: Wrong password. 1 more attempt before a 30 s wait.
vault.passwordRemaining_other: Wrong password. {{count}} more attempts before a 30 s wait.
vault.answersRemaining_one: Incorrect answers. {{count}} attempt left before a 30 s wait.
vault.answersRemaining_other: Incorrect answers. {{count}} attempts left before a 30 s wait.

questions.pet: What was the name of your first pet?
questions.city: In which city were you born?
questions.school: What was the name of your elementary school?
questions.friend: What was the name of your best childhood friend?
questions.street: On which street did you live as a child?

vault.pausedHelp: You went over the allowed attempts. Your private notes are still encrypted and safe.
vault.lastHelp: After that you get one last attempt. If it fails, you can only reset private notes.
vault.lastPassword: Last attempt. If the password is wrong, you can only reset private notes.
vault.lastAnswers: Last attempt. If the answers are wrong, you can only reset private notes.
vault.exhaustedHelp: Private notes can no longer be unlocked. Reset them to create a new password.
vault.limitHelp: You went over the 10 allowed attempts. Your private notes are still encrypted and safe. Choose how to continue:
vault.tryLaterHelp: You can enter the password again in 30 minutes. It will be your last attempt.
vault.wipeOptionHelp: You create a new password. Your current private notes move to the Trash and can no longer be opened.
vault.lastFailed: The password is wrong and there are no attempts left. To keep using private notes, reset them and create a new password.
vault.wipeHelp: The password and security questions are deleted. Then you create new ones, like the first time.
vault.wipeEmpty: You have no private notes: only the password and questions are deleted.
vault.wipeCount_one: Your private note moves to the Trash. It stays encrypted with the old password: it can't be opened or restored, only deleted.
vault.wipeCount_other: Your {{count}} private notes move to the Trash. They stay encrypted with the old password: they can't be opened or restored, only deleted.
vault.waitMinutes: Too many failed attempts. Wait {{minutes}} minutes.
vault.orphanedHelp: It was encrypted with a password that no longer exists. It can't be restored; it can only be deleted.
vault.deleteHelp: This note will be deleted and can't be recovered.
